roundTwoChecks: Invariant, not deadline. resolveBroadcastSessions now counts decided ids (a record, or ErrNotFound) and refuses `ErrUnavailable` when the count is not len(requested). The only way an id goes unlaunched is the loop's break on groupCtx.Err(). groupCtx ends for three reasons: a read error, which Wait returns anyway; the budget; or the request's own context, which ends when the client disconnects. The count also refuses that third case, which is not a deadline. Every launched read either records its outcome or returns its error, so no id is lost silently. Duplicate ids are counted once per launch and so stay consistent with len(requested), and a real-binary broadcast naming one id twice gives one recipient.
